act.name: Transfer of Property Act, 1882
act.source_name: Official Gazette of India / India Code
act.source_authority: Ministry of Law and Justice, Government of India
act.description: An Act regulating the transfer of property by act of parties, leases, mortgages, and property transactions.

sections.title: Rights and Liabilities of Lessor and Lessee
sections.chapter: Chapter V - Of Leases of Immovable Property
sections.text: In the absence of a contract or local usage to the contrary, the lessor and lessee of immovable property respectively possess the rights and are subject to the liabilities mentioned... The lessor is bound to disclose to the lessee any material defect in the property... and the lessee is entitled to peaceful enjoyment of the property during the lease period.
sections.plain_language_summary: Landlord must disclose material property defects and grant peaceful possession to the tenant. Tenant must pay rent and maintain property.
